QuestInfo.name: [Ren] Pressed Plum Blossoms
QuestInfo.0: You're not quite back to how you were when you traveled with Saya, but not by much. With Saya's power at your fingertips, you should be able to use a more advanced Plum Blossom Sword skills.
QuestInfo.1:
Go to where you hid the book of Plum Blossom Sword teachings.
It was at the #m410000230# in Cheong-woon Valley.
QuestInfo.2: You re-read the Plum Blossom Sword book. Now you can harness more of Saya's power.
